header.subtitle: From intimate black-box performances to grand proscenium stagings — each production carries a message, each character carries a truth.

cta.text: ATR has staged 40+ productions across Rajasthan and nationally at festivals including Bharat Rang Mahotsav

items.title: Kalpurush
items.subtitle: Krantikari Veer Savarkar
items.description: An epic biographical play depicting the life and struggle of revolutionary Vinayak Damodar Savarkar. Produced through a 90-day intensive workshop and staged at Birla Auditorium, Jawahar Kala Kendra & Ravindra Manch. Directed by and starring Dr. Chandradeep Hada.

items.title: Meri Maa
items.subtitle: Lok Sanskriti aur Rajasthan Darshan
items.description: Adapted by Jairoop Jeevan and directed by Dr. Chandradeep Hada, this production explores the rich folk culture and traditions of Rajasthan. Performed on 23rd July 2023 at Ravindra Manch, Jaipur, with SNA Chairman Dr. Sandhya Purecha in attendance as Chief Guest.

items.title: Agnipath
items.subtitle: Path of Fire
items.description: Staged for Sangeet Natak Akademi's national 'Rang Swadhinta Jashna' on India's 78th Independence Day. Written by Lt. Mahendra Jain and directed by Dr. Chandradeep Hada, this play honours the unsung heroes of India's freedom struggle.

items.title: Sanatan Ra Prahari
items.subtitle: Maharaja Mansingh Ji Pahla
items.description: Performed in the traditional Dhundhadi language on the open stage of Sarvato Bhadra at City Palace, Jaipur. Staged on the culmination of a 30-day Sanskritik Virasat workshop, directed by Dr. Chandradeep Hada.

items.title: Ham Natak Kyo Karte Hain
items.subtitle: Why We Perform
items.description: An introspective performance examining the role of theatre in society, asking why we create, perform, and watch drama. Directed by Dr. Chandradeep Hada and staged at Ravindra Manch, Jaipur.

items.title: Kisi Aur Ka Sapna
items.subtitle: Someone Else's Dream
items.description: A touching narrative focusing on personal aspirations, societal expectations, and individual choices in modern India. Staged at Ravindra Manch, Jaipur, after a 30-day intensive workshop.
